summary: EESTI ENERGIA AS (LEI 5493005044RTLQ5RZU70; EE registry code 10421629) is identifier-confirmed, registered in Estonia. The Government of Estonia is indicatively recorded as controlling owner per Wikidata, making this a possible state-owned enterprise; this is a presence-only indicator sourced from a crowd-sourced knowledge base and is not an authoritative determination. GLEIF data shows the entity has an unknown parent recorded under a reporting exception (parent does not consolidate the subject) and consolidates at least three direct subsidiaries — Enefit OÜ, Enefit Oy, and ENEFIT INDUSTRY AS — with the ownership chain spanning three corporate layers, meeting the AMLA threshold for complex ownership. Four current board members are confirmed by the Estonian e-Business Register: Andrus Durejko and Marlen Tamm (from 2023-04-03), Lauri Karp (from 2024-09-10), and Gerrit Mäesalu (from 2026-06-22); several additional individuals hold positions recorded as "other means" by the same register, including Jürgen Ligi (from 2024-08-02), who is flagged by OpenSanctions, EveryPolitician, and OpenAleph as a possible PEP — however, all four signals are name-match only with no birth date or nationality confirmed, so the identification is not conclusive. Two structural risk signals are raised at medium confidence: opaque ownership (an anonymous entity in the chain, per GLEIF) and complex ownership layers (three corporate layers, per GLEIF); the possible state-controlled status is a structural observation, not an adverse finding. No gaps were recorded in the evidence packet.
